isometric-perspective.title: Isometric Perspective Module
isometric-perspective.settings_main_hint: Toggle whether the isometric perspective is applied to the canvas.
isometric-perspective.settings_height_hi: Toggle whether token sprites adjust their position to reflect their elevation.
isometric-perspective.settings_visuals_h: Displays a circular shadow and a vertical red line to indicate token elevation. Requires 'Enable Height Adjustment' to be active.
isometric-perspective.settings_dynamic_t: (BETA FEATURE. USE WITH CAUTION) Adjusts the visibility of tiles dynamically with the positioning of tokens. See how this feature works here.
isometric-perspective.settings_token_sor: (BETA FEATURE. USE WITH CAUTION. V12+ ONLY) Automatically adjusts the tokens sort property value when moving it around the canvas.
isometric-perspective.settings_toggle_de: Toggle depth sort for newly created tiles while active.
isometric-perspective.settings_token_sil: (BETA FEATURE WITH PERFORMANCE ISSUES. USE SPARENTLY) Creates a shadow effect on the token when behind a tile. GPU mode isn't working properly, but it is lightning fast. CPU is always heavy in processing, but a higher chunk option is faster trading quality fidelity. 'Chunk Size = 2' is the probably the better mode.
isometric-perspective.settings_welcome_h: Displays a window with module information when starting Foundry VTT.
isometric-perspective.keybindings_increa: Increases the opacity of always visible tiles linked with walls.
isometric-perspective.keybindings_decrea: Decreases the opacity of always visible tiles linked with walls.
isometric-perspective.scene_transform_hi: Apply isometric transformation to the background image.
isometric-perspective.scene_scale_hint_1: Adjust scale of art in isometric mode (Range: 0.5x to 3x). The "Offset Background (Pixels)" in
isometric-perspective.scene_scale_hint_2: Grid tab can be used to shift/move the background.
isometric-perspective.scene_dropdown_hin: Choose an isometric projection type for this scene.
isometric-perspective.custom_projection_: Enter the values of a custom isometric projection obtained from the app website.
isometric-perspective.scene_perspective_: The scene is seen through a virtual camera: the grid recedes towards the horizon and tokens shrink as they move away. Perspective: Grid Only leaves the map as it is, for maps already painted in perspective. Perspective: Grid and Map also puts the map image and the tiles in perspective (walls, lights and drawings are never warped: place them after setting up the camera). While this window is open, the edge of the grid is outlined in orange and every change previews live on the canvas.
How far the floor leans away from the viewer, in degrees. 0 = seen straight from above.
Turns the grid on the floor, in degrees. Values other than 0 give a two-point perspective.
Field of view of the camera, in degrees: how quickly cells shrink with distance. 0 = no vanishing point, parallel lines stay parallel.
Size of the floor at the center of the grid. 1 = cells as big as the scene grid.
Moves the grid (and the map, when it is put in perspective) over the scene, in pixels. Hold and drag ✥ to move it by hand. Tokens stay on their cells when the camera changes.
Hold and drag to move the grid
Columns × rows of the perspective grid, centered on the map. Leave empty to cover the whole map.
Save the scene once to turn the perspective on. After that, every change below previews live on the canvas.
Style of the perspective grid, which replaces the grid of the Grid tab. Lines get thinner with distance and have a faint contrasting outline, so they stay visible on any map.

Standing tokens are upright on the center of their cell, as big as the cell, with their status effects in a column beside them. Flat tokens lie on the floor, following the shape of the cell. Each token (or the prototype token of an actor) can override this in its own Isometric tab.
isometric-perspective.token_enableIsomet: Disable isometric transformation on this token.
isometric-perspective.token_perspectiveP: Only used in perspective scenes. Standing tokens are upright and shrink with distance, flat tokens lie on the floor. Set it on the prototype token of an actor to apply it to all of its tokens.
isometric-perspective.token_standingImag: Full-height art shown instead of the token image while the token stands (perspective scenes) and in isometric scenes, with its feet on the cell. Height is in cells and can be taller than one cell; the width follows the image. Leave empty to use the token image. Set it on the prototype token to use it for every token of the actor.
isometric-perspective.token_artOffset_hi: Offset the token art position in pixels.
isometric-perspective.token_artOffset_mo: Hold and drag to fine-tune X and Y
isometric-perspective.token_isoAnchor_hi: Change the anchor of the token. If 'Save?' is unchecked, doesn't apply the new anchor configuration.
isometric-perspective.token_resetAlignme: Click to reset the token alignment configuration
isometric-perspective.token_scale_hint: Adjust scale of token art when in isometric perspective (0.01x to 3x).
isometric-perspective.token_disableScale: If checked, this token will not auto-resize its art when its dimensions change.
isometric-perspective.tile_enableIsometr: Disable isometric transformation on this tile.
Enable tile depth sorting on this tile.
isometric-perspective.tile_set_tile_faci: Some tiles , for examples tiles representing a wall, may need additional data for the depth sorting feature to know how to properly sort them.
isometric-perspective.tile_artOffset_hin: Offset the tile art position in pixels.
isometric-perspective.tile_enableIsometr: Display an alignment gizmo centered on the tile anchor point to give a better idea of where a tile should be offset if needed
isometric-perspective.tile_artOffset_mou: Hold and drag to fine-tune X and Y
isometric-perspective.tile_scale_hint: Adjust scale of tile art when in isometric perspective (0.01x to 3x).
isometric-perspective.tile_flip_hint: Flip the tile art horizontally. Works only with isometric transformation on.
isometric-perspective.tile_occluding_hin: If checked, this tile will hide tokens with a shadow effect.
isometric-perspective.tile_link_wall_hin: Click the button to select a wall. This wall will be used to determine the tile's visibility with a selected token.
isometric-perspective.tile_decoupleScale: If checked, the tile will not auto-resize its art when its dimensions change.
isometric-perspective.region_enableIsome: Enable depth sorting by linking tiles to this region.
Sort linked tiles as back walls when tokens interact with this region
isometric-perspective.region_link_back_t: Select tiles to mark them as a room's back walls, theses tiles will be depth sorted below tokens if tokens are within the region boundaries
isometric-perspective.welcome.title: Welcome to Isometric Perspective!
isometric-perspective.welcome.subtitle: This module transforms your maps and tokens into an isometric perspective in Foundry VTT, offering a unique and immersive gaming experience.
isometric-perspective.welcome.feature_ta: Use either native isometric maps or top-down maps in isometric perspective with any projection as true isometric, dimetric and even a custom one.
Token and Tile Adjustments and Features
Fine-tune position and scale, easily arrange tiles in canvas, and enable visual cues for elevation tokens and automatically sort tokens in canvas.
Create immersive isometric environments automatically hiding them based on token positions, with the dynamic tile feature.

on GitHub. You can disable this screen on module settings.
